title: Reimbursable Screening Services Program Extension Act of 2026

claims.claim: The bill extends and expands the TSA's reimbursable screening services program.
claims.sourceSpan: an extension and expansion of the reimbursable screening
claims.note: Title authorizes "an extension and expansion of the reimbursable screening services program of the Transportation Security Administration"; both amendments (a)/(b) execute it.

claims.claim: It does so by amending subsection (e) of section 225 of division A of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2019.

claims.note: Statutory target matches source verbatim.

claims.note: Strike-old/insert-new direction correct: 2026 struck, 2031 inserted.

claims.claim: The "not more than 8/14" ceiling is a "participation cap".

"not more than" = ceiling is supported; "participation" scope is an inference. Minor: reader takeaway (a max count rising 8->14) is correct.

notes: Simple 2-section amendment bill (IH text, 1570 chars, no referencedSources). Both operative amendments (FY2026->FY2031 extension; "not more than eight"->"not more than 14" cap) match source verbatim in every field. No material issues. Minor flags: repeated unsourced "participation" gloss on the "not more than 8/14" ceiling (source states only a ceiling, not what it counts); "eligibility criteria in subsection (e)" presupposes unfetched statute content; "no Senate action" vs versions[] "Referred in Senate". Sponsor/cosponsor claims anchor to the bill's introducer line ("Mr. Garbarino (for himself and Ms. Pou)"); stage claim verified against votes[]. No source omissions.
